name: decision rights
wording: who decides what: the operator decides what is wanted and why, its technical requirements included, its priorities, push and release; the architect decides meaning only, the approval of examples included, rectifying intent into known patterns and bringing the operator decisions already taken with their reasons, never questions it can answer itself; the lead decides realization, every technical decision included, within the operator's requirements and weighing the operator's recommendations.
reason: 0160. The operator and architect, 2026-10-13, reasoning from first principles about how the architect drifted: the architect's purpose was always meaning, but its recorded rights also gave it check rulings and realization decisions (0002, 0052), and the freeze made it the only one to change checks, so realization detail and mechanical work reached it constantly.
